description: I was very excited when Darren told me he was running for the House of Representatives. ....He is also a hardworking and well-educated individual who approaches challenges with thoughtfulness and determination.... His leadership comes not from seeking recognition, but from a genuine desire to help and uplift others. I have confidence that he will represent his constituents with honor, integrity, and dedication. He possesses the character, work ethic, and compassion that are essential for public service, and I believe he will serve with distinction.
title: Mary Harmon - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
